    Baking

    Chocolate Chip Cookies

    The smell of browning butter is the first sign these are on the way, and nobody stays out of the kitchen for long after that. Bon Appétit's best: dark brown sugar for deep toffee flavour, crisp edges, chewy middles and puddles of dark chocolate. Keep a tray of dough balls in the freezer and warm cookies are only ever a few minutes away.

    Serves 16 cookiesPrep 20 minCook 20 min
    VegetarianMake ahead

    Chicken

    Buffalo Wings

    Sticky fingers, a pile of napkins and someone always reaching for just one more. The wings are floured, chilled and fried until they crackle, then tossed in the classic butter and hot sauce mix.

    Serves 5 (10 wings)Prep 10 min + 1–1½ hr chillingCook 15 min
    Party foodSpicy

    Pasta

    Mac and Cheese

    The dish people hover over at the holiday table, waiting for the first spoon to break through the crust. Three cheeses melted into a sauce of evaporated milk and cream, layered with more cheese and baked until the top is golden and crackling and the middle pulls into long, stretchy strings.

    Serves 8–10
    Vegetarian

    Salads

    Caesar Salad

    A salad that eats like a proper meal. Crisp cos, salty bacon, shredded chicken thigh, jammy eggs and garlic-butter croutons, tossed in Beerenberg Caesar dressing and buried under parmesan. The eggs and croutons can be made ahead, so it comes together in minutes when everyone's hungry.

    Serves 4Prep 20 minCook 20 min
    Make ahead
